tickets.title: US001 - Prerequisite Validation
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want the roadmap to validate course prerequisites, so that I do not plan a course I am ineligible to take.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if a course is accepted when all catalog prerequisites are completed.
- PASS if an unmet prerequisite identifies the missing course and blocks current-term enrollment.
- FAIL if a student without a prerequisite can enroll without an authorized override.

analysis.ambiguity1: Stakeholder requirement: the Head of Advising wants advisors to override prerequisites when a student has 'special permission.' This is ambiguous because it does not define who may grant permission, which evidence is required, whether every prerequisite is overridable, or when an override expires. Developers need the authorized roles, approval workflow, required reason/evidence, eligible courses, and audit rules before implementation.
analysis.ambiguity2: Stakeholder requirement: the Registrar says the system must link to the 'live database' and prevent a student from adding a full class to a roadmap. This is ambiguous because 'live' has no freshness or outage definition, and 'roadmap' could mean current registration or future planning. Developers need the data refresh interval, behavior during database outages, the term boundary, and whether waitlisted or future offerings may be planned.
analysis.conflictSolution: Conflict: the Registrar wants full classes blocked from roadmaps using live availability, while Advising wants students to plan four years ahead when future capacity is unknown. Resolution: distinguish a non-binding long-term plan from current-term enrollment. Future courses may be placed with an 'availability not guaranteed' label. For the active registration term, refresh authoritative availability and block adding a full section, while offering alternatives or a waitlist link. This preserves long-range planning without presenting uncertain capacity as enrollable.
analysis.nfr1: Security and Privacy: an authenticated student may retrieve only their own schedule and roadmap; every direct request for another student's data must be denied and recorded in the security log.
analysis.nfr2: Auditability: every prerequisite override must record the advisor identity, student, course, timestamp, reason, and resulting decision in an append-only audit log searchable by authorized staff.
analysis.nfr3: Data Freshness and Reliability: during active registration, displayed section capacity must be no more than 60 seconds behind the Registrar database; if freshness cannot be verified, enrollment actions must be disabled and marked unavailable.
